rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-09 outranks every other source: claim p1-123 keeps inc-126 (the delete landing on the overall dashboard) for DR1's service split, claims p1-085 and p1-101 drop the session flash and keep ?deleted=1 on the delete redirect, and claim p1-069 (with ruling:sam-2026-10-07 p1-010) lets a real cross-service constraint override the prototype; so landing on the live-animals list is ruled out, Design Release 2.1's next-visit placement has no carrier left, and the only placement the rulings allow is the page the ?deleted=1 redirect lands on.
outcome: The delete keeps landing on the overall dashboard with ?deleted=1, and that page shows the success message 'Notification has been deleted' (Design Release 2.1's wording when the reference is not known): on the workspace stack and in CDP the INS front door's dashboard; in the animals frontend's own fit run, with no INS front-door URL configured, /live-animals?deleted=1 as today. The live-animals list shows no deletion message on a later visit. The 9 October ruling keeps the landing (inc-126) and drops the session flash, so the message can only travel with the ?deleted=1 redirect to where the delete lands; Design Release 2.1's placement (no banner on the dashboard, the message on the list's next visit) cannot be carried.
